Before the epoch the farm wires 102060 POA and sets aside 21870 minutes of labour, all sunk before any prize is counted. Walk the trail by hand: it is short enough to walk and long enough to trip a farm. A mirror can be painted, a raven can be borrowed, but a copper must be lived, and the farm has lived nothing. The farm tried to buy the epoch and found the epoch is not for sale.
